item.name: Healing Potion
item.description: A vial of red liquid that accelerates natural healing when consumed.

consumable.description: Allows the user to immediately make a natural healing roll at +2.

item.name: Stim Pack
item.description: A military-grade injectable stimulant used in emergencies.

consumable.description: Removes the Shaken condition and grants +1 to Agility-based rolls for 3 rounds.

item.name: Holy Water Flask
item.description: A small glass flask filled with consecrated water.

consumable.description: When thrown, affects undead and demons as a Smite effect for one round.
